scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: P.T. or Y.T.: principal and yield tokens splitting a yield-bearing asset. Basis: a future's premium over spot. Funding: payments between perp longs and shorts. Covered call: selling upside for a premium. Delta-neutral: price moves roughly cancel out.
scenes.cap: PT / YT: principal and yield tokens splitting a yield-bearing asset. Basis: a future's premium over spot. Funding: payments between perp longs and shorts. Covered call: selling upside for a premium. Delta-neutral: price moves roughly cancel out.
